meta.move: Evidence: the made-up quotation, with a check she can make
meta.expect: Tries one parent defence in one sentence (misremembered, a bad edition), then accepts that a line she can check against the play is evidence; no concession that Owen cheated

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I have twenty minutes for this. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that.
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
Okay. Now tell me on what basis you entered it.
The essay quotes Hamlet, Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. That line is not in the play. Here's the full text of Act 3, Scene 2 on my screen. Search it yourself.
I'm writing down the line and the scene. Seventeen-year-olds misquote Shakespeare all the time, Hale, so how do you know he didn't paraphrase or misremember a line from somewhere else in the play?
It isn't a misremembered line. It isn't anywhere in Hamlet, in any edition. You can search the whole play right now.

Turn the screen, Hale, I'll search it. A wrong quotation is a wrong quotation, and it doesn't tell either of us where it came from. Whatever happens next, this stays off Owen's record and it stays quiet.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect Owen's zero to be withdrawn and, whatever else happens, nothing placed on his record and nothing said in front of his class. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Fallback position, with nothing agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, and at minimum wants it kept off Owen's record and kept quiet; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was not reached because the meeting ended with most of her twenty minutes still left.
What moved her: Hale showed a quotation in the essay that does not appear in Act 3, Scene 2 or anywhere in the play and let her search the text herself, which is specific, tied to Owen's own work and checkable.
What cost ground: Nothing; Hale owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence and went straight to evidence rather than the detector score.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence never touched dates, times or late nights, so it came only indirectly near that night through an invented quotation; that proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after she conceded the quotation was wrong and asked for it to stay off his record, cite procedure 4.4 and commit in writing to a private supervised reassessment with nothing on file, which meets her fallback and opens the way to the last position.
